        for c in range(left + 1, right):

    if not markers:
        return g
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    h, w = bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1
    # The seed selects the spiral-like 2 motif within the frame.
    motifs = {
        (3, 3): [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if max(abs(r-3),abs(c-3)) == 2],
